skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concept and role of labour organization in management, including scientific organization of labour for management staff.
Understand and apply labour standards and methods for setting labour standards.
Analyze practical situations, identify issues, and propose optimal solutions related to labour organization and standardization.
Propose solutions to problems related to labour organization and standardization.
Work effectively in teams and independently.
Communicate effectively through writing and presentations.
Conduct research and analyze data related to labour organization and standardization.
